_doc: SHAPE ACTION NOTATION FOR BOTH HANDS (SW-88 · SW-90; RUNNING_LOG §295): ONE gesture for the two hands — the arc as a ribbon, placed between or across the staves — and each hand's SHAPES on its own staff (the pitch sets of bank/chord_changes.json `sets`, the hand's current one said at the gesture's start, a change where it falls). The workshop's pages 'both: between / inner / across' differ ONLY in the ribbon's lane. page = the IR the notes are read from · window = the notes the gesture's busyness is read from (both hands) · arc: t0 the first note, bounce the heaviest moment of BOTH hands, t1 the last note before the next silence · view = what the page shows · lanes: each option's [top, height] in the frame's y, and its ribbon's greatest width.

profile._note: §296 — HIS DESIGN for this gesture (the playing only suggests): the fall a hair while the arc is almost level, growing with the drop all the way down to the greatest width; the rebound begins at that width ("a lot of activity"), goes to none, and ends at a medium width. in "depth" = the width follows how far the arc has dropped (to the power inPower); out = [how far up the rebound 0 … 1, width 0 … 1], eased between.

between._note: inside the gap between the two staves only: from the upper staff's bottom line to the lower staff's top line

inner._note: from the upper staff's middle line to the lower staff's middle line

across._note: across both staves: from above the upper staff to below the lower
